text: This report addresses an appeal concerning one variance sought respecting a Signage Master Plan proposal for four first party illuminated wall signs displaying static copy (the "Proposed Signs"). Two of the proposed signs are located on the sixth storey of the easterly and westerly elevations, and two of the proposed signs are located on the first, second and third storeys of the easterly and westerly elevations of the six storey building at the property municipally known as 1120 Dupont Street (the "Premises"). The Proposed Signs are intended to identify a new self-storage facility on the Premises. A Signage Master Plan was originally applied for by Isabella Cerelli of Pride Signs Ltd. (the "Applicant").
